extracted.intended_audience: cancer researchers and other health care professionals seeking AACR research funding
extracted.subtask_description: Information page listing current AACR funding opportunities (grant name, amount, deadlines) and directing prospective applicants to program-specific guidelines and eligibility criteria. It is aimed at researchers preparing to apply for AACR grants or to monitor open opportunities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Review Program Guidelines / Eligibility Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Prospective applicants are encouraged to carefully review all eligibility criteria found within the Program Guidelines for each grant before applying.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should consult the specific Program Guidelines for each listed grant to confirm eligibility, required documents, and any program‑specific instructions; this page lists opportunities but refers to individual program guidelines for substantive requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required listing metadata for each funding opportunity
rubrics_metrics.description: Each listed funding opportunity includes fields such as Grant Amount, Application Deadline, Decision Date, Start of Grant Term, and Grant Duration.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use these metadata items to determine whether to apply and to plan timelines and budgeting; applicants should track the application deadline and any letter-of-intent deadlines, note the decision date and grant start date, and confirm the grant duration and award amount in the program guidelines.
